name: process_output
title: Read Process Output
description: Reads buffered stdout/stderr from a process handle using cursors, so callers never re-fetch the whole log. Pass back the cursors from the previous call.

process_id.description: Opaque process handle returned by process_start. 128-bit entropy, never parsed.

stdout_cursor.description: Stdout byte offset to resume from; pass back the cursor from the previous call.

stderr_cursor.description: Stderr byte offset to resume from; pass back the cursor from the previous call.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to return per call.

wait_ms.description: Long-poll for new output up to this long.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

stdout_cursor.description: Stdout resume offset for the next call.

stderr_cursor.description: Stderr resume offset for the next call.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

stdout_truncated.description: True when stdout was cut to bounds.

stdout_dropped_bytes.description: Stdout bytes discarded under the memory cap.

stderr_truncated.description: True when stderr was cut to bounds.

stderr_dropped_bytes.description: Stderr bytes discarded under the memory cap.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
